The best part about them is the hole in the center of the tip which makes it so that you can see the writing you're highlighting as you go over it. It's one of those things you never knew you wanted until you got it. It's great for highlighting something printed off that might be typed in smaller font or for underlining a word.Yes, the ink from my printed documents that I print off my home printer still smear a little with these but I think that's more to do with the paper I use & the ink heaviness from my printer (& how soon after printing that I start highlighting). Though, it's actually not as bad as with other highlighters I've used.I've had these highlighters since March & it's now July & they're still working well. I keep them stored with the lid pointed down in a pin holder cup on my desk at all times though & the temp remains consistent. So I don't know how well they'd hold up stored in a backpack & exposed to extreme temps. I have no reason to think they wouldn't do alright but, I'm not sure. I'm concerned that tip might dry out easily but I have no idea since this is the 1st time I've seen a tip like this.I have noticed that the ink from highlighting typed words has started to turn the tips black but, interestingly enough, it hasn't shown up on the paper when I use the marker. The picture I'm including of the colors is one I just made, with my marker tips having visible black ink on the ends of them & that black didn't transfer to the paper.I also included a picture of the tip & a video because I just noticed that the entire tip, except for the part that touches the paper, is enclosed in clear plastic to protect it from drying out I assume. I tried to show this on the video but not sure how well it can be seen.The colors are bold but still able to see through well when the writing is typed in black ink. So far, I have no complaints.

reviews.title: Makes Highlighting Easy
reviews.body: These highlighters are some of the best I’ve used. The clear view tip lets me see exactly where the highlight will end, which makes my notes look neat without overshooting the text. The chisel tip is versatile for both thin underlines and wide coverage.The fluorescent colors are bold and eye catching but not too dark to obscure the words underneath. They don’t bleed through most notebook or textbook paper, which is a big plus. The ink also lasts a long time, even with frequent use.With eight different colors in the pack, I can color code my notes for school, work, or personal projects. They’re reliable, smooth, and great for both students and teachers. Highly recommend if you want clean and vibrant highlighting every time.

reviews.title: Highlighting These Highlighters Greatness
reviews.body: I just love these highlighters. At first I am willing to admit I was skeptical, they were more expensive than some other generic highlighters. But I came to realize that the you really get that Sharpie ink flowing quality. As a college student I find these great! They are the perfect size for highlighting my books. And they are not very heavy, so I can glide right through the words confidently knowing I won’t miss what i’m highlighting. These are a must have! I say this because I know what it feels like to get many highlighters that just work, but these don’t just work, they excel. And I am grateful to own them. I’ll attach a picture of my favorite colors! They just highlight great!

reviews.title: Great Highlighter Set for Schoolwork — Perfect Reward for My Client
reviews.body: My client earned the Sharpie Clear View Highlighter Sticks (8‑pack) at the end of the week, and they were exactly what he needed for his schoolwork and daily tasks. The clear view tip makes it really easy to see what you’re highlighting, which helps prevent going over lines or making the page messy. The colors are bright, smooth, and smear‑resistant, which is great for worksheets, notes, and planners.He liked that the set comes with multiple colors so he can organize his work better, and the chisel tip makes it easy to switch between thin and thick lines. They’re also small enough to fit in a pencil pouch without taking up too much space.I’m giving them 4 out of 5 stars because while they work really well, the sticks are a little smaller than expected. Still, they’re a great set for students or anyone who needs reliable highlighters. My client was excited to earn them, and he’s already using them in session.
